The second task vector is computed against the already-merged intermediate rather than the unmodified base: `tmp = b + λ(f1-b)` and then `out = tmp + λ(f2-tmp)`, which expands to `0.6·tmp + 0.4·f2 = 0.6·b + 0.24·(f1-b) + 0.4·(f2-b)`, not the required `b + 0.4(f1-b) + 0.4(f2-b)`. This violates Required result step 2 (and is precisely the ordering hazard the objective calls out), so the 48 merged tensors will exceed the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance in grading. Everything else — name/shared-tensor verification, the 48 and 160 count checks, unchanged tensors copied bit-exactly from the base, single output file — conforms.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
